test_cases.description: Invoking `af plan --clear` opens the KnowledgeStore, sets every node in plan_nodes to completed via persist_node_status, truncates all four session-scoped tables, and exits with code 0 reporting the node count.
preconditions: DuckDB knowledge store is initialised with a valid plan containing 3 nodes in mixed statuses (pending, in_progress, failed)
Session-scoped tables (runs, session_outcomes, review_findings, drift_findings) contain at least one row each
Nightshift daemon PID guard is not active
Config points to the test DuckDB file
test_cases.expected: Exit code 0; stdout contains '3 nodes cleared'; all rows in plan_nodes have status='completed'; all four session-scoped tables contain zero rows
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = CliRunner().invoke(af_plan_cmd, ['--clear'])
assert result.exit_code == 0
assert '3' in result.output
conn = open_test_db()
assert all(row.status == 'completed' for row in conn.execute('SELECT status FROM plan_nodes').fetchall())
for tbl in ['runs', 'session_outcomes', 'review_findings', 'drift_findings']:
    assert conn.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tbl}').fetchone()[0] == 0

assert result.exit_code == 0

assert all(r.status == 'completed' for r in spec_a_rows)
spec_b_rows = conn.execute("SELECT status FROM plan_nodes WHERE spec='spec_b'").fetchall()

property_tests.description: For any plan with N nodes (N >= 0) in any combination of statuses, after af plan --clear exits with code 0, every node in plan_nodes has status='completed' and the reported cleared count equals N.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate plans with N nodes (N drawn from 0..50) where each node's status is sampled uniformly from ['pending', 'in_progress', 'failed', 'blocked', 'completed']; use hypothesis.strategies.lists and hypothesis.strategies.sampled_from
property_tests.invariant_check:
result = CliRunner().invoke(af_plan_cmd, ['--clear'])
assert result.exit_code == 0
rows = conn.execute('SELECT status FROM plan_nodes').fetchall()
assert all(r[0] == 'completed' for r in rows)
assert str(len(rows)) in result.output

property_tests.description: For any plan with nodes belonging to multiple specs, after af plan --clear --spec NAME, only nodes for NAME have status='completed' and all other nodes are unchanged.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate plans with 2-5 distinct spec names and 1-10 nodes per spec; randomly assign statuses; pick one spec name as the target; use hypothesis.strategies.text for spec names and hypothesis.strategies.lists for nodes
property_tests.invariant_check:
result = CliRunner().invoke(af_plan_cmd, ['--clear', '--spec', target_spec])
assert result.exit_code == 0
target_rows = conn.execute(f"SELECT status FROM plan_nodes WHERE spec='{target_spec}'").fetchall()
assert all(r[0] == 'completed' for r in target_rows)
other_rows = conn.execute(f"SELECT status, original_status FROM plan_nodes WHERE spec!='{target_spec}'").fetchall()
assert all(r[0] == r[1] for r in other_rows)

property_tests.description: For any non-empty state of the four session-scoped tables, after af plan --clear exits with code 0, all four tables contain zero rows.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate 1-20 rows for each of the four session tables (runs, session_outcomes, review_findings, drift_findings) with random valid data; use hypothesis.strategies.integers and hypothesis.strategies.text for field values
property_tests.invariant_check:
result = CliRunner().invoke(af_plan_cmd, ['--clear'])
assert result.exit_code == 0
for tbl in ['runs', 'session_outcomes', 'review_findings', 'drift_findings']:
